title: Let's see how people react to a game I made with the heavy help of Claude
author: ForkedPush
selftext:
The free demo of I Just Wanted to Fish is out on Steam.  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5351000/I\_Just\_Wanted\_to\_Fish\_Demo/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5351000/I_Just_Wanted_to_Fish_Demo/)

comments.author: PoshiHero
comments.body: Visual cartoon com personagem com proporcoes proximas da realidade :/ . As animacoes estão duras e sem timing. Pontos positivos. O shader da agua está  bem bonito. A iluminação de por do sol está decente.  E a UI está com bons efeitos

comments.author: Briskfall
comments.body:
Oh yeah... I remember this one...

... I can just say that the faces and motions are kind of distracting, and slightly drops my immersion.

The rest looks stellar though. But that also might be why the humanoids are distracting, they stand out too much from the rest of the set. And the gap creates a feeling of "lack of cohesiveness."

replies.author: ForkedPush
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback, I am looking into how I can improve this.
